Persist project paused=false and allow task execution and ideation from saved checkpoints. Does not clear global runner stop or individually paused tasks.
Mark candidate dismissed; unchanged evidence is suppressed. If selected, its active task pauses.
Mark candidate deferred; it cannot be selected until explicitly reopened. If selected, its active task pauses.
Return candidate to proposed status without starting planning; explicit selection remains required.

scope.description: Provider-reported measurement scope, such as session or attempt.

raw.description: Retained native provider usage payload; shape depends on provider.

quota_pool.description: Explicit shared quota alias, or resolved provider pool identity.

quota_fresh.description: Null when no native quota observation is available; connectivity alone does not prove quota.

BudgetPolicy.description: Finite attempt and active-runtime ceilings are required. Verification reserves must be below their respective ceilings; positive reserves are required before coder admission. Optional token/cost ceilings require explicit per-attempt reservations.

raw_metadata.description: Uninterpreted native quota response, including provider metadata and extensions. Null for historical observations without retained metadata.

applicability.description: Model/account applicability remains unverified. Native metadata is preserved without inferring a provider applicability schema; routing stays conservative.

status.description: May be absent on historical candidates.

expected_benefit.description: Expected concrete outcome; required on newly generated candidates, optional historically.

uncertainty.description: Assumptions or remaining validation; nonempty for generated opportunities.

effort_estimate.description: Rough scoped effort with reason; required on generated candidates.

problem_kind.description: Generated observed defects require persisted verification-failure evidence. Source-only hypotheses and prospective improvements are opportunities.

kind.description: Native attempt, synthetic legacy unknown entry, deterministic verification, or preflight that made no model turn. Verification and preflight are not AI inference spend.

entries.description: Full entries on task usage routes; null in compact notification summaries.

unknown_runtime_attempts.description: Historical attempts with missing runtime. Admission blocks instead of counting these as zero.

goal.description: Saved user goal, at most 4000 UTF-8 bytes.

constraints.description: Saved constraints, at most 8000 UTF-8 bytes.

priorities.description: Saved priorities, at most 4000 UTF-8 bytes.

max_candidates.description: 1–12 sets the saved shortlist bound; omitted or 0 uses the configured schedule maximum, default 4.

fresh.description: For this manual operation only, bypass unchanged-input generation skip. Existing deduplication and budget checks still apply.

active_runtime_ms.description: Required when usage is supplied; operator-observed active runtime, not inferred zero.

BudgetReconciliation.description: Only uncertain or uncertain_released reservations, or existing legacy session IDs with unknown accounting, may be reconciled. Null/omitted usage releases the concurrent runner slot and retains unknown token/cost/runtime reservations. Supplied usage must have scope attempt and requires observed active_runtime_ms.

WorkflowConfiguration.description: Read-only startup mode; edit mode on disk and restart. Other settings reload live.
